data.narrative:
Riverlane is a Series C quantum computing company founded by Steve Brierley that has raised $120M+ to date. The quantum computing sector comprises 3 public comparables (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

A peer-median approach was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow quantum computing set—fewer than 3 datapoints met filtering criteria when controlling for stage and valuation tier. Accordingly, the primary valuation method applied was stage-progression analysis. Using Riverlane's $120M total raised as a baseline proxy and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C to subsequent-stage transitions yields an implied valuation of $204M.

The triangulated range is $173M to $235M, with a median of $204M, derived from the single applicable method. Key uncertainties affecting this estimate include the precision of the stage-progression multiplier for the quantum hardware/software subsector and the representativeness of the $120M raised figure as a valuation proxy absent transaction data. A more granular valuation would require either recent financing round terms for same-stage peers or revenue/profitability metrics for Riverlane; neither is available in this dataset.
